name: Tia Hohenwerfen
original_name: ティア・ホーエンヴェルフェン
source:
Colleague of Tooru and Hiromi. She is afraid of spiders. Often called just Tia” or “Verufen-sensei” because her name is hard to pronounce. Like many others on this island, Tia is also a native, but unlike Masaki, it is suggested that Tia is a purebred.

[Taken from [url=https://vnerogereview.wordpress.com/2013/08/04/pure-love-story-on-a-fantasy-island-review-of-130726amairo-islenauts/]Visual Novels and Eroge Review[/url]]
